_comment: Cache-safe temporal E2E (anthropic). Two-run cross-turn pattern with >=3s gap so the volatile temporal suffix DIFFERS between turns, while the stable system prefix stays cacheable. Expect run1 cache_write>0, run2 cache_read>0. Run: `set -a; source .env; set +a; unset ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL; SESS=tmp_anthropic_$(date +%s); ./target/release/dag_engine run tests/graphs/agents/provider_cache_temporal_anthropic_e2e.json --agent-session-id $SESS --include-extra-info; sleep 3; ./target/release/dag_engine run tests/graphs/agents/provider_cache_temporal_anthropic_e2e.json --agent-session-id $SESS --include-extra-info`

config.system_message: You are a deterministic cache-test agent. Reply with EXACTLY one line: 'cache_test_done'. The text below is STABLE filler that forms the cacheable system prefix; it never changes between turns. Ignore it semantically. Colmena is a Rust-native AI agent orchestration library with a hexagonal architecture spanning domain, application, and infrastructure layers, and it supports OpenAI, Anthropic, and Gemini providers behind a single LlmRepository trait. The DAG engine wires nodes declared in JSON; each node implements ExecutableNode and emits outputs under the output convention. Built-in nodes include sql_query, http_request, python_script, image_generation, image_edit, tts, suspend, secure_suspend, trigger_webhook, router, output_parser, subgraph, and the orchestrator. Synthetic tools include the gsheets and gdocs families, sql_inspect_attachment, sql_bulk_insert_from_attachment, attachment_run_python, load_attachment, load_skill, and describe_tool. Attachments flow through the OutputStorageRepository port and persist uniformly at registration. Skills load on demand via include_dir with YAML frontmatter and a sixty-four kilobyte cap. Lazy tool loading reveals schemas progressively through describe_tool. Conversational memory persists across sessions in Postgres keyed by agent_session_id. Secure values are encrypted at rest with AES-256-GCM and require a key at startup. The orchestrator coordinates a planner, an executor, a critic loop, and bridge tasks; subgraph nodes nest and HITL suspension propagates upward through suspend nodes using the canonical question and answer response format. RAG uses pgvector. Streaming SSE carries node-start, node-end, and finish events; the finish event aggregates usage across every LlmUsage emitted during the run and surfaces prompt, completion, total, thinking, cache-read, and cache-write token counts. Prompt caching cuts repeat-prefix cost dramatically on Anthropic; Gemini provides implicit caching above its own minimums; OpenAI caches automatically for long prefixes. The workspace depends on sqlx, tokio, reqwest, schemars, serde, anyhow, thiserror, pyo3, and napi-rs. CI runs on develop and enforces Conventional Commits plus formatting and deny-warnings. The python sandbox validates code through an AST check before execution and wraps it in a timeout. The gsheets node speaks the Google Sheets REST API; the gdocs node speaks the Google Docs API plus Drive. The co-edit guard tracks revisions and computes paragraph diffs. SQL bulk insert streams CSV into Postgres via COPY FROM STDIN. The orchestrator emits phase markers and the engine validates topology at load time.
